comparison.objective: Route a lamp cable into a holder while keeping the entire cable clear of a hot plate; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-cable routing and plug placement under a keep-out constraint versus rigid fine-tool engagement, collar rotation and impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Plug must be seated and released while the cable remains outside the hazard and satisfies final clearance; candidate uses force, energy, travel, rebound and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: No meaningful mechanism or tested ability overlaps beyond generic placement and safety constraints.
